description: There is a dominating family of size d, every dominating family has size at least d, and every family of size less than d is not dominating.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.dominatingNumber_spec :
  (∃ D,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsDominating D ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑D = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.dominatingNumber) ∧
    (∀ (D : Set (ℕ → ℕ)),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsDominating D →
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.dominatingNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑D) ∧
      ∀ (D : Set (ℕ → ℕ)),
        Cardinal.mk ↑D < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.dominatingNumber →
          ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsDominating D
